Chapter 191: Chapter 1 I don’t think your view on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is comprehensive (Please subscribe)_2

Even many Evolvers, despite not training, would buy it to study, after all, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is currently ranked fifty-third on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

In terms of fame, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is bigger, as making a leap of several tens of ranks in a short period of time can further spark the curiosity of other Evolvers.

…

Evening.

Lin Yuan finished training.

He went outside the main building, preparing to dine with his parents and sister.

...

Since Lin Yuan spent most of his time training,

even though the family lived in the same estate, they didn’t see each other often.

Thus, Lin Yuan made it a point to come out for a meal every so often.

“Brother, I am now a First Rank Evolver…” Lin Yi boasted while eating.

Actually, Lin Yi becoming a First Rank Evolver so quickly was quite normal.

When Lin Yuan entered the Fourth Rank, he had performed Marrow Cleansing for Lin Yi.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, under Marrow Cleansing, a strong foundation was laid for Lin Yi.

Therefore, no matter which Evolution Path she took, it was easy, given that the foundation was there.

Of course, this ease was only apparent in the First Rank, at most the Second Layer; from the Tenth or Eleventh Segments of the Second Layer, she could only rely on herself.

“Xiaoyuan, you are not young anymore, even if your main focus is on the path of evolution, you should also consider having a child…”

Mrs. Lu Qiong couldn’t help but say.

Nowadays, because of Lin Yuan, the Lin Family had leapt from being an obscure family in Dongning City to becoming one of the top families on Canglan Star.

Mrs. Lu Qiong occasionally also connected to the Virtual World, unaware of how many families and powerful forces on Canglan Star wanted to introduce their precious daughters to Lin Yuan.

“There’s no rush on this matter, we can talk about it later.”

Lin Yuan said casually.

The powerful Evolvers of the Main World had different attitudes towards progeny.

Many Evolvers focused on the path of evolution felt progeny was superfluous; Lin Yuan held a similar view.

No matter where or when, personal strength is always the fundamental base.

As for offspring, they are just a numerical accumulation.

As long as Lin Yuan was there, even if alone, it would still be the most top-tier family nobility.

If one day Lin Yuan was gone, even if they had many descendants, it would be of no use.

It would be just like monkeys scattering upon the fall of a tree.

As the family was chatting.

“Master, someone has come to visit.”

The voice of the digital assistant sounded in his ear.

“Who?”

Lin Yuan asked.

“Canglan Star Governor Song Wuyang.”

…

Inside the main building’s reception room.

Lin Yuan and Governor Song Wuyang sat facing each other.

“Truly a once-in-millennia evolutionary genius of our Canglan Star…”

Governor Song Wuyang was very pleased with Lin Yuan.

Recently in the arena competition, Lin Yuan had dominated the whole event with his Fourth Rank strength.

To think, a Fourth Rank Evolver under a hundred years old being born on Canglan Star was also a nice boost to his governance performance.

“It was merely by luck.”

Lin Yuan shook his head.

“Luck?”

“In tens of thousands of years on Canglan Star, could Mr. Lin be the only one lucky?”

Governor Song jokingly said.

“However, regarding the trial of the Chikun Star Lord, Mr. Lin need not worry…”

Governor Song comforted.

Lin Yuan not passing the Seven Star Cave trial was no secret.

Though Lin Yuan was a Fourth Rank Evolver, at that time, tens of thousands of Fourth Rank Evolvers participated in the Seven Star Cave trial, and very few passed.

The Seven Star Cave trial initiated by the Chikun Star Lord targeted the comprehensive aspects of the challengers, where strength was only one aspect and not even the most significant.

“What a pity.”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, displaying a hint of regret.

In the arena, Lin Yuan simply showed his Fourth Rank strength, but the Chikun Star Lord was able, through his own judgment and the “source video” sent by the Goddess of Wisdom, to confirm that Lin Yuan had begun to comprehend the rules.

Ultimately becoming a Golden Pattern Challenger.

As for the others?

Even among beings on the same level as the Chikun Star Lord, without the “source video”, one still couldn’t confirm the true extent of Lin Yuan’s abilities.

He was just perceived as an ordinary Fourth Rank.

Such a Fourth Rank, among the tens of thousands of Evolvers entering the Seven Star Cave trial, was quite common.

As a result, it seemed quite normal to outsiders that Lin Yuan had failed the Seven Star Cave World trial.

It was very inconspicuous.

“Governor Song came this time for….”

The two exchanged pleasantries for a moment before Lin Yuan took the initiative to ask.

“There is something I need Mr. Lin’s help with…”

Song Wuyang paused for a moment, then tentatively asked, “Mr. Lin is the youngest Fourth Rank Evolver on Canglan Star, would you consider our invitation to become an honorary professor at Canglan Evolution Academy?”

“Don’t worry, it’s just honorary, apart from showing up for the first few classes, afterwards you can come and go as you please…”

“Even if Mr. Lin leaves Canglan Star in the future, as long as you don’t renounce the honorary professor title, you can always enjoy the many benefits that come with it…”

After finishing, Song Wuyang carefully observed Lin Yuan’s reaction.

Canglan Evolution Academy, being the highest institute on Canglan Star, gathered the most promising of the younger generation.

Since they were the younger generation, they were naturally not very old, and Lin Yuan, as a Fourth Rank Evolver under one hundred years old, had great influence among the youth.

If Lin Yuan could become an Honorary Professor of Canglan Evolution Academy, it would undoubtedly be a significant inspiration for those students.

After all, having their idol in the school, who among those students wouldn’t be fully motivated to study and practice?

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan contemplated for a while, then agreed.

Primarily because this honorary professor role was really very liberal, having no binding force on him, and even when teaching students, it was in the virtual world, no need to leave his estate.

Besides, he could also collect a salary of one hundred thousand civilization coins per month.

Of course, with Lin Yuan’s current fortune, he wasn’t concerned about the money.

However, occasionally providing guidance to other evolvers was also a form of self-reflection for Lin Yuan, and with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, there might be unexpected gains.

“Since that’s the case.”

“Then it’s settled.”

Song Wuyang breathed a sigh of relief; he had been genuinely worried that Lin Yuan might refuse before his arrival.

….

Since he had agreed to become an honorary professor at Canglan Evolution Academy.

Lin Yuan also felt it improper to not even show his face.

In the virtual world, the president of Canglan Higher Evolution Academy, alongside various professors and experts, personally welcomed Lin Yuan.

“Professor Lin is young and promising, making us old fellows truly ashamed…” Professor Chu said with a laugh.

He was also the most senior among the professors, not only a professor but also the vice president.

“I never thought I’d live to see such a talented Evolver,” Mr. Lu couldn’t help saying as he sized Lin Yuan up.

After chatting for a while, naturally, the topic shifted to Evolution Paths.

After all, everyone was either an expert or a professor, regularly engaging with knowledge in the field of evolution, which made it easy to find topics for discussion.

And since the topic had shifted to Evolution Paths, it was impossible not to mention the recently popular Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Even on the main world of the Chikun Star Domain, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had caused quite a stir, and as Canglan Star was the initial world for this path, its popularity was naturally higher.

All the experts and professors present had basically purchased the first three ranks of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path for study.

Seeing that Lin Yuan sat there silently while the professors and experts discussed enthusiastically, Professor Chu, not wanting Lin Yuan to feel isolated, took the initiative to ask, “Professor Lin, what are your views on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

As soon as the question was asked.

Everyone quieted down.

They were all looking forward to hearing Lin Yuan’s opinion.

They also wanted to hear the perspective of the most talented Evolver in the history of Canglan Star.

“My view on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

A hint of amusement crossed Lin Yuan’s face.

If it had been any other question, he might not have had an answer.

But regarding the Martial Path Evolutionary Path… naturally, there were no issues.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path is based on vital energy…”

Lin Yuan roughly shared his views, but only limited to the First and Second Layer.

The higher ranks were difficult to articulate merely by speech.

The surrounding experts and professors listened intently, nodding occasionally.

Once Lin Yuan finished, everyone started discussing in low voices.

Moments later.

Professor Lu and a few other professors discussed for a bit and then spoke up, “Professor Lin, your understanding is good, but somewhat one-sided and fails to reflect the true profundity of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

“My understanding of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is one-sided?”

Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.
